scope: Selected visual and interaction checks after the voice and information-hierarchy completion pass. This is not physical-device, microphone, GPS, VoiceOver or usability evidence.

observations.evidence: Illustrated map remains visible behind the medium drawer; city/search/weather/next action read as one hierarchy; decorative quick filters are absent.
Place results use one-column horizontal rows at 402 px so image, title, summary and visit metadata remain readable.
Context, time shortcuts, sample prompts and composer are visible without a duplicate root header; mic and Send are separate labelled controls.
Intro states that the microphone is not accessed or recorded; sample listening leads to editable transcript review before Send.
The first action is to plan or browse; the three zero-stat tiles are hidden when they communicate no useful state.
Hero, facts and About/Story are readable above the fold; only one fixed action row remains with Listen and Add to plan.

limitations: Voice uses a sample transcript and never requests microphone access.
Maps and focused navigation remain illustrative fixtures without live GPS or rerouting.
No physical iPhone, VoiceOver, background-audio interruption or field usability session was run.
